fjord.notes: Farkeep's own: dun, stocky, deep in the barrel and short in the leg; the roached mane standing up the crest in three bands (pale side, the dark centre, pale side); the dark dorsal stripe over the croup into the tail's dark core; a mealy muzzle. Saddle and bridle in dark leather, brass iron and bit. Seat on the saddle's seat (pommel at seat.x+5, clear of the rider's knee; cantle at seat.x-5); ground under the hooves' centre. Walk: a four-beat (near hind, near fore, far hind, far fore on a duty of about 0.62), the barrel level so the seat holds (seatDy 0); walk1 and walk3 (the held beats) the diagonal supports, walk2 and walk4 the lateral ones with the head nodded a row down; the tail a texel back on walk1, forward on walk3.

mustang.notes: The plains horse: a buckskin paint, lean and a cannon longer than the fjord; black points (the mane falling down the crest, the long low-set tail, the fore legs below the knee, the dark muzzle) and a tobiano's white over the flank that runs down both hind legs. A plain dark saddle, steel iron and bit. Seat on the saddle's seat; ground under the hooves' centre. Walk: a four-beat (near hind, near fore, far hind, far fore on a duty of about 0.62), the barrel level so the seat holds (seatDy 0); walk1 and walk3 (the held beats) the diagonal supports, walk2 and walk4 the lateral ones with the head nodded a row down; the tail a texel back on walk1, forward on walk3.

icelandic.notes: Small and shaggy: a chestnut on short sturdy legs, short in the back; the thick flaxen mane falling down the near side in loose strands, the forelock over the brow, a full flaxen tail nearly to the ground, a white snip. The saddle sits the short back, so the rider's pack overhangs the croup, as it would. Seat on the saddle's seat; ground under the hooves' centre. Walk: a four-beat (near hind, near fore, far hind, far fore on a duty of about 0.62), the barrel level so the seat holds (seatDy 0); walk1 and walk3 (the held beats) the diagonal supports, walk2 and walk4 the lateral ones with the head nodded a row down; the tail a texel back on walk1, forward on walk3.

arabian.notes: A grey, fine in the bone: a short level back, the long neck arched high, the small head with the dished face (the face line held back under a broad forehead, the small dark muzzle of a grey's skin coming forward), fine long legs on small hooves, the dark tail carried up off the croup in a plume. Red leather, brass. Its nod carries the head a texel forward as well as down. Seat on the saddle's seat; ground under the hooves' centre. Walk: a four-beat (near hind, near fore, far hind, far fore on a duty of about 0.62), the barrel level so the seat holds (seatDy 0); walk1 and walk3 (the held beats) the diagonal supports, walk2 and walk4 the lateral ones with the head nodded a row down; the tail a texel back on walk1, forward on walk3.

percheron.notes: The draught wall: black, massive (42×33 — the breed demands a column past the ±4 band: it must stand the biggest in the stable), the round croup, the neck heavy and high in the crest under a thick mane, the big straight head, legs like posts lit down their fronts on broad horn hooves. The black is lifted off the outline and drawn by its lights (crest, croup, brow, the front of the face) so the form reads; the eye sits dark in a lit brow. Warm leather that reads on black. Seat on the saddle's seat; ground under the hooves' centre. Walk: a four-beat (near hind, near fore, far hind, far fore on a duty of about 0.62), the barrel level so the seat holds (seatDy 0); walk1 and walk3 (the held beats) the diagonal supports, walk2 and walk4 the lateral ones with the head nodded a row down; the tail a texel back on walk1, forward on walk3.

donkey.notes: The caravan's pack animal: grey, the big head on a low neck, the long ears (the far one in shade), the short dark mane, the cross (the dark stripe down the back and the band down the shoulder), the pale muzzle, eye ring and belly, thin legs on small upright hooves, a thin tail ending in a dark tuft; a rope halter. It carries what it carried: two iron-banded crates lashed on a cream canvas pad, the rope running down between them to the girth, a breeching strap round the rump. Seat: the pack's ridge — the rope between the crates at their lids — so a courier composed there sits on the load (the game rides no donkey). Ground under the hooves' centre. Walk: a four-beat (near hind, near fore, far hind, far fore on a duty of about 0.62), the barrel level so the seat holds (seatDy 0); walk1 and walk3 (the held beats) the diagonal supports, walk2 and walk4 the lateral ones with the head nodded a row down; the tail a texel back on walk1, forward on walk3.
